registration.physical_scale: One common world/pixel scale calibrated to the existing female SOUTH head width, including ears, at alpha>128. Authored family-scale choice, not a recovered native height.
registration.units: width and center_x are Qud cell-width units (2/3 world); height and center_z are world units. No per-facing rescale.
